pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED READING: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.1 Guided Reading : Reading Fluency (2 Sessions) • Speed • Expression •
Topic 2.5: Guided Reading: Reading Aloud

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Reading: Reading Aloud. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can you show love to your family members?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify vocabulary related to the family in a text
2. appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GUIDED READING: READING ALOUD
Subject: ARABIC · Grade: Grade 8
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Guided Reading: Reading Aloud helps you succeed in ARABIC. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GUIDED READING: READING ALOUD
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify vocabulary related to the family in a text

What this means
In this part you learn to identify vocabulary related to the family in a text. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify vocabulary related to the family in a text.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Reading: Reading Aloud”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify vocabulary related to the family in a text. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Reading: Reading Aloud to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Guided Reading: Reading Aloud is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Guided Reading: Reading Aloud”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify vocabulary related to the family in a text)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Guided Reading: Reading Aloud to a partner. (skill: appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Guided Reading: Reading Aloud to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify vocabulary related to the family in a text.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Guided Reading: Reading Aloud from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Guided Reading: Reading Aloud: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 8 learner study Guided Reading: Reading Aloud?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can you show love to your family members?
2. How can you tell the meaning of a new word in a text?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Guided Reading: Reading Aloud means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify vocabulary related to the family in a text.
5. Be able to: appreciate reading strategies to acquire reading skills.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
